purpose: Estimate source-reviewed whole-interval tracking availability on a systematic 10-Hz grid without requiring 30-fps shoe clicks
original_review_grid_rule: source_frame modulo 6 equals 0; 23 prior frames within interval
new_interleaved_grid_rule: source_frame modulo 6 equals 3; 23 frames within interval
primary_denominator_after_completion: 46 systematically spaced frames x six players = 276 player slots
all_85_frame_review_status: optional_for_frame_by_frame_adjudication; not required for sampled whole-interval coverage
limitation: A systematic 10-Hz grid measures sampled frames across the interval; it does not certify the other 92 source frames or exact serve-to-dead-ball bounds.
